commit 8ceffcb29e61ba882a011b1e4d73ca03691fdc2e
Author: Chao Yu <chao@kernel.org>
Date:   Wed Jun 14 17:39:47 2017 +0800

    f2fs: move sysfs code from super.c to fs/f2fs/sysfs.c
    
    Codes related to sysfs and procfs are dispersive and mixed with sb
    related codes, but actually these codes are independent from others,
    so split them from super.c, and reorgnize and manger them in sysfs.c.
    
    Signed-off-by: Chao Yu <yuchao0@huawei.com>
    Signed-off-by: Jaegeuk Kim <jaegeuk@kern
bic_trace_step.reason: The code shows f2fs_sbi_show() reads a single unsigned integer via offset. No attribute for extension_list, extension_count, or hot_ext_count is defined in this commit, so the vulnerable construct (race condition on those fields) is not present.
